item.description: Retail Jeweller Wongs Jewellers partners with Derek’s for Chinese New Year collaboration Two Liverpool independents, Wongs Jewellers and sandwich shop Derek’s, have teamed up to celebrate Chinese New Year with the launch of a limited edition sandwich. item.description: Retail Jeweller Two arrested after jewellery shop raid in Southend Two men have been arrested after a jewellery shop was targeted in Southend on Monday 16 February. Two arrested after jewellery shop raid in Southend Ruth Faulkner

item.title: Retail Jeweller Festival unveils full content programme for March 2026 event
item.description: Retail Jeweller Retail Jeweller Festival unveils full content programme for March 2026 event Retail Jeweller has announced the full content programme for the 2026 Retail Jeweller Festival, taking place on 16–17 March, bringing together independent retailers, multiples, suppliers and industry leaders for two days of buying, insight, strategy and networking.
